scope: Implemented coordinated package refresh and authorized Node 24.22.3 security age exemption

scripts.verify: node scripts/check-dependency-policy.mjs && node scripts/check-image-size.mjs && node scripts/check-source-map.mjs && node scripts/check-frontmatter.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vocs build

candidateWorkspacePolicy:
# Exact pins and deliberate dependency updates.
savePrefix: ""
frozenLockfile: true
minimumReleaseAge: 10080
minimumReleaseAgeStrict: true
minimumReleaseAgeIgnoreMissingTime: false
blockExoticSubdeps: true
trustPolicy: no-downgrade
trustPolicyExclude:
  - semver@6.3.1

# Make content verification explicit rather than relying on pnpm defaults.
verifyStoreIntegrity: true
strictStorePkgContentCheck: true

# Keep local and CI installs on the reviewed toolchain.
engineStrict: true
packageManagerStrictVersion: true
verifyDepsBeforeRun: error

# Dependencies may execute install-time code only after explicit review.
strictDepBuilds: true
dangerouslyAllowAllBuilds: false
allowBuilds:
  esbuild: true
  es5-ext: false
  vue-demi: false

# Surface incompatible dependency combinations during installation.
strictPeerDependencies: true

# Reviewed fixes scoped to their introducing dependencies.
overrides:
  "vocs>image-size": 2.0.4
  "remark-mdx-frontmatter>toml": 5.0.1
  "@scalar/json-magic>undici": 7.30.2
  source-map-js: 1.2.2

hooks.prepare: npm run build && npm run build:minified

packages.deprecated: The Intersection Observer polyfill is no longer needed and can safely be removed. Intersection Observer has been Baseline since 2019.

hooks.prepare: husky && npm run prepare:patch && node scripts/check-release.js || npm run build:prepare
npm run build && npm run build-readme
